title: Business Architecture Guardrails Catalogue
description: Catalogue of non-negotiable constraints, mandatory standards, and concrete patterns for the Business architecture domain. Aligned to Policy-as-Code conventions (AWS Service Control Policies, Azure Policy).

meta.description: Rules and minimum standards that must be followed in Business Architecture.
purpose: Protects the organisation from decisions that violate non-negotiable constraints
Makes compliance and regulatory requirements architecturally explicit
Provides clear go/no-go criteria for architecture review
Reduces risk by codifying hard limits alongside soft principles
Enables automated guardrail checking in the decision governance workflow

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

rule.description: The mandatory constraint or required pattern

scope.description: What the rule applies to (systems, environments, data classifications, etc.)

rationale.description: Why this is mandatory — often references a principle or compliance requirement

enforcement.description: How compliance is checked (automated scan, review gate, manual audit, etc.)

exception-process.description: How an exception can be raised (or 'No exceptions')
